scenario_scope: Coordinated intake of EGGROLL and three primary comparators spanning population evolution strategies, forward-only zeroth-order language-model fine-tuning, and local forward-only credit assignment.

cases.decision_rationale: The chapter already owns update algorithms, run state, topology, checkpointing, and qualification. The new literature expands the learning-rule family above gradient optimizer selection without creating another executable boundary.
promotion_blockers: learning-rule and architecture effects remain coupled
non_claims: does not establish that gradients are obsolete
does not establish an alternative-learning winner

cases.decision_rationale: A separate chapter would split one Training Run Contract and encourage method labels to escape their state, evaluator, checkpoint, resource, and evidence obligations.
required_before_drafting: not applicable; update the existing owner and bounded consumers
evidence_transition_preconditions: a future distinct stack interface would require fresh chapter-boundary adjudication
promotion_blockers: method diversity alone is not a chapter boundary
non_claims: does not reserve or defer a future chapter

validation_boundary: Records existing-chapter integration and rejects a duplicate chapter. It does not validate any learning implementation, source benchmark, theorem outside its assumptions, transfer claim, or training policy.
non_claims: does not authorize a model-training campaign or release
